entries.name: T1.27 gap-tolerant 10-of-14 GMM sensitivity
entries.decision_rule: Re-extract the analytical sample under a gap-tolerant 10-of-14 presence rule with length-variance standardisation; re-embed with FROZEN PCA loadings; refit a k=7 GMM; compute ARI between the gap-tolerant regimes and the original locked regimes. Report the sample size (target ~45-55% of the eligible population) and an included-vs-excluded comparison on at least five baseline characteristics. High ARI indicates the regime structure is stable to the gap-tolerant rule; low ARI indicates the strict-presence rule materially shapes the regimes and Stage-4 Option A is the consequential re-extraction. This is GMM-only sensitivity; no full TDA pipeline rerun.

prose_direction.high_ari: Report the regime structure as stable to the gap-tolerant presence rule; the strict-presence sample is not a material driver of the regimes.
prose_direction.low_ari: Report that the presence rule materially shapes the regimes; flag Stage-4 Option A as the consequential full re-extraction and temper any regime-stability claim.
